tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the 3D stage and the FPV video. The app is dark only (color-scheme: dark).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Floating panel and float-box fill, over a 6px backdrop blur so the map shows through.

tokens.name: panel-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque surfaces that sit over the map: tool palette, flyouts, context menu, options bar, search hits, notices.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every 1px border and divider: panel edges, title-bar rule, control borders, .sep, inspector section rules.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, panel, panel-solid and every control fill.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, h4 headers, field labels, counts, inactive segment labels, the ⠿ grip. Reads on panel-solid at about 9:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: active (.on) and primary buttons, selected segment and tab, selection outlines, range and checkbox accents, the area frame, links and OK messages.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and the knob outline ON an accent fill. Never use plain text colour on accent.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings and errors in text (.err, .bad), the readout's warn state and the notice border.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive state. Also the Cut tool's colour.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text, number, url inputs and selects.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: A destructive item's label in the context menu, on panel-solid.

tokens.name: map-ground
tokens.usage: The 2D/3D editor canvas behind the map tiles.

tokens.name: badge-ink
tokens.usage: Version badge text, on badge over anything.

tokens.name: frame-shade
tokens.usage: Dims the map outside the yellow-green area frame (box-shadow spread).

tokens.name: wash-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on palette buttons, flyout entries, element rows (0.06 there).

tokens.name: wash-on
tokens.usage: Active palette and flyout entry, with a border in the tool's colour.

tokens.name: wash-menu
tokens.usage: Context-menu hover and the count pill fill.

tokens.name: rotate-knob
tokens.usage: The rotate knob above the area frame (outlined in accent-ink).

tokens.name: tool-select
tokens.usage: Select tool dot and active border.

tokens.name: tool-measure
tokens.usage: Measure tool and the cyan measure chains on the plan.

tokens.name: tool-cut
tokens.usage: Cut tool and its notch preview (same as danger).

tokens.name: tool-scatter
tokens.usage: Tree brush and its strip / area / zone outlines.

tokens.name: tool-void
tokens.usage: Void tool (floor holes); about 4:1 on panel-solid, the darkest tool hue.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drag a rectangle on the map; it snaps flush to close neighbours
styles.usage: Everything by default: labels, buttons, inputs, lists. The UI is dense and 12px is the base.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel and float-box title bars, set UPPERCASE.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: h4 group headers inside a panel, UPPERCASE, in dim.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Inspector section captions (.st) and context-menu heads, UPPERCASE, in dim.

styles.name: glyph
styles.usage: Unicode glyph buttons on the tool palette; title-bar buttons use 13px.

styles.name: osd
styles.usage: FPV on-screen display over video, with a 4px black text-shadow.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Map readout pill: live distances and angles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between palette and flyout buttons; label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Toolbar gaps, palette padding, inspector row gap, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default .row gap, grip gap, float-box body gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel body padding, inspector column gap, .sep margin, map-overlay inset.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Options-bar column gap, context-menu item padding.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Panels, the readout pill and the version badge.

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: Tool palette, flyouts, context menu, options bar.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, segmented controls, tabs, palette buttons, list rows, the map canvas.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Plan SVG overlay and area frame over the map.
